card.name: Dose-adjustment text before toxicity grades
card.fires_on: Spaces, numbers and small linking words in dose-modification tables and lists, just before a toxicity grade, section number, or adverse-reaction term like nausea or toxicity.

modes.label: Space before numbers
modes.description: A blank or space token right before a dose number, grade or section reference in dose-reduction text.

modes.label: Grade and unit numbers
modes.description: The number 3 after Grade or after a count unit such as mm in toxicity tables.

modes.label: Words before nausea or toxicity
modes.description: Linking words or the middle of aprepitant just before nausea or toxicity terms.
